title: VeriCEMS Verifier Verdict and Vote
description: Off-chain verifier evaluation payload and commit-reveal vote commitment for a telemetry batch.

verifier_address.description: 20-byte EVM address of the verifier node.

model_hash.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase 32-byte SHA-256 hash of the ONNX detector weights and physics rule config.

input_hash.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase 32-byte hash of the batch input (equals batch merkle_root).

score_bp.description: Quantized anomaly score in integer basis points (0..10000).

reason_codes.description: Ordered list of triggered detection reason codes (empty array when verdict == 0).

salt.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase 32-byte random salt used in the commit phase.

vote_commitment.description: keccak256(abi.encode(batch_id, model_hash, input_hash, score_bp, verdict, salt)).
